subject.title: 自定义模型Openrouter升级后没有办法使用了

question: Should this cross-repository OpenRouter report be closed here with instructions to refile in OpenClaw core, or transferred if repository administration permits?
rationale: The code evidence makes the scope mismatch clear, but the target repository’s conservative cleanup profile does not permit automatic closure merely because an issue belongs elsewhere.

options.title: Transfer or redirect
options.body: Route the report to OpenClaw core and preserve the adjacent authentication-overwrite context for investigation.

options.title: Request details first
options.body: Leave it open temporarily and ask for versions, redacted configuration, model ID, and logs before routing.

recommendation.title: Transfer or redirect
recommendation.body: Route the report to OpenClaw core and preserve the adjacent authentication-overwrite context for investigation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest connection to Graincrawl’s current scope and release ownership.
